text: When agent_workspace has diverged from origin due to a force-push, the correct recovery is git reset --hard origin/agent_workspace (not rebase or merge) — this is safe because agent_workspace is an agent-only branch and local commits from a failed prior run should be discarded

Security Analyzer: files.json showing empty scannersCompleted for all files does not mean scanners did not run — candidates.json is authoritative; treat files.json scannersCompleted as unreliable when it conflicts with actual scanner output in candidates.json
